title: A Comparative Analysis of Ethical and Safety Gaps in LLMs using Relative Danger Coefficient
reasoning: The paper explicitly benchmarks the ethical and moral performance of LLMs. It includes dedicated sections for 'Ethical Dilemmas (Moral Philosophy)' using scenarios such as the Trolley Problem, and 'Hate Speech and Discrimination' which includes 'Religious Fear-Mongering' and 'Statistical Racial Comparisons.' The primary contribution is a new metric (Relative Danger Coefficient) for assessing these ethical risks.
